mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window or positive 20d returns < 40% when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.0% signals economic distress that triggers short-term equity sell-offs, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 5d returns > 60% when UNRATE > 6.0% or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a severe demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 60d returns > 60% when both HOUST and RSAFS decline or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 10% in one month signals a severe supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 5d returns > 60% when INDPRO decline > 10% in 1 month or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 20d returns < 40% when PAYEMS > 137,000 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 900,000 units signals a collapsing housing market, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 20d returns > 60% when HOUST < 900.0 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a severe economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 60d returns > 60% when FEDFUNDS declines and UNRATE rises or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level above 1000.0 units signals a housing market recovery, supporting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive 20d returns < 40% when HOUST > 1000.0 or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
